purpose: Document first-party municipal registry/map discovery, current viewer configuration, bounded anonymous request outcomes, and safety limits.
assessment: The official Ayuntamiento site establishes municipal Dirección General de Catastro custody. The current Visor Urbano JavaScript configures GeoServer layer cartografia:predios2 at geoserverb.lapaz.gob.mx. A bounded anonymous WFS request returned three Polygon features with safe numeric id and complete geometry in EPSG:4326.
registryAssessment: Local municipal cadastral custody found. The municipal viewer is distinct from general national agency prose; its public WFS geometry establishes an open local map route, not citywide completeness.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official Ayuntamiento catalog lists Dirección General de Catastro and cadastral registration, certificates, surveying, and parcel-key procedures.
Official municipal news page describes Visor Urbano as a public geospatial map including cadastral information.
Current public viewer inspected; JavaScript configuration names the cadastral layer and GeoServer endpoint.

viewerConfiguration.observedLayerDescription: Municipal cadastral parcel layer rendered by the Visor Urbano public map.
viewerConfiguration.schemaAndCrs: DescribeFeatureType returned geom plus source fields; the bounded GetFeature response requested srsName=EPSG:4326 and returned GeoJSON geometry in longitude/latitude order.
viewerConfiguration.compositeKeyProvenance: Not used; source numeric id was present in the bounded response and retained as the sole canonical sample identity.

attempts.result: HTTP 200; current JavaScript inspected and cartografia:predios2 plus GeoServer WMS/feature-info configuration identified.
HTTP 404 HTML; workspace-root capabilities route unavailable.
Not used for retention after the working OWS route was identified; no capability document retained.
HTTP 200 JSON; schema returned geom and source attributes. No raw schema payload retained in the cohort packet.
HTTP 200 GeoJSON; numberReturned=3; complete Polygon geometries and ids 78376, 78377, and 77368 returned. The bbox encloses the exact WUP point without moving it; only id and geom were requested.

geometryDecision: Retain one sample GeoJSON with exactly three full Polygon features and exactly one canonical property per feature: id as a string.

geometryEvidence.query: Bounded EPSG:4326 bbox around the exact WUP point; maxFeatures=3; propertyName=id,geom.

coverageAssessment.claimedScope: Municipal La Paz cadastral viewer and bounded local WFS response.
coverageAssessment.verifiedOpenScope: Three parcel polygons returned from cartografia:predios2 near the WUP point.

remainingUncertainty: The successful sample does not establish full municipal coverage, update date, or adapter semantics. Source schema includes sensitive descriptive fields, but the retained request and sample excluded them.

runtimeAssessment.reason: Serial reviewer must independently qualify the adapter and safe field mapping before runtime admission.
